evidence.title: Omarchy - Beautiful, fun & agentic Linux by DHH

name: Omarchy
summary: Linux distribution by DHH with curated defaults, AI agents, community themes and plugins.
description: Omarchy is a Linux distribution by David Heinemeier Hansson: write the ISO to a USB stick, answer five questions and hand back a finished desktop in under a minute. It ships a configured editor (Neovim), terminals and language setups (Ruby on Rails, Laravel, Node.js via mise), invites you to pick a default AI agent on first boot, and has community galleries for themes and plugins.
contains: ISO install in under two minutes (35 seconds on fast machines)
AI agents to debug crashes and build plugins/themes
runs on old hardware (2011 ThinkPad X220 with 2GB RAM)
